name: Art History: Gender and Women's Studies

rules.title: A thesis for the doctoral degree must constitute original scholarship and must be a distinct contribution to knowledge
An additional 9 credits in Art History, of which 3 credits must be a graduate option-approved 500- or 600-level ARTH course
Ph.D. students must demonstrate proficiency in one or more languages other than English that is related to their dissertation research, as determined by their supervisor
